cases.name: Deidre Nicole "Nadia" Silas
cases.about:
She had been an investigator for the state Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) for about 6 months. She previously also worked for the Illinois Department of Juvenile Justice. She graduated from Illinois State University in 2008 with a degree in criminal justice. She received her master's degree in public administration in 2019.

Her father Roy Graham, who brought Silas to the U.S. from Jamaica when she was 10. He said his daughter was a mother to two young kids. She had a master’s degree in criminal justice and was drawn to children. 

“She’s a go-getter (and had a) smile on her face all the time,” Graham said. ‘Loving, caring, cherishing, loved kids to death. That’s what she (does). She loves kids to death.” 

Her obituary said, "Deidre was born on July 30th, 1985 in Kingston, Jamaica. Raised in Ocho Rios, Great Pond where she attended preschool at the age of 4 then onto primary school.
 
She then moved to the United States in December 1995. Since coming to the states she flourished in school accomplishing many accolades. She made the National Honor Roll for many years  while attending high school, she participated in the Boys and Girls Club, the Fashionetta cotillion, mentor for Scope, participated in the UBC youth ministry, she was the president of the Caribbean Student Association in 2007. She then went on the receive her Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice Science in 2008, Master’s of Public Administration in  2019, certification in Project Management in 2020 and certification in Human Resource Management in 2020. Deidre has accomplished so much during her short time on this earth. She wasn’t only driven by accomplishing her degrees and accolades. But she also focused on starting her family. She married Andre Silas 2017. They went on to have Ashton Silas now 5 and Amelia Silas now 2.
 
She accepted Christ at an early age. Her church home was Union Baptist Church. She enjoyed spending time with her family and friends. She was the heartbeat of her house especially whenever Andre was deployed for a couple of years. Her favorite hobbies- reading, playing with her kids, playing mom to her younger cousins, family time and cooking. 
 
On Tuesday January 4th, 2022 she was called home to god to be one of his angels."
